ev.q: the first verified human case of WNV meningoencephalitis in 2003 was reported from South Carolina
130 corvids (crows and related species) and 63 other dead birds with WNV infection were reported from 28 states
Fifty-three WNV-positive mosquito pools were reported from eight states
summarizes West Nile virus (WNV) surveillance data reported to CDC through ArboNET
